Technical Specification

Paper Bags Technical Specification

The table below is written for industrial RFQ comparison. Final production specification is confirmed by sample approval, filling test and export packing test.

Paper material120gsm / 150gsm / 180gsm kraft paper; 190gsm / 250gsm / 300gsm white card
Handle typeCotton rope, twisted paper handle, ribbon handle, die-cut handle
Handle pull strength≥ 12 kgf per handle pair for 250gsm paper bag target
Bottom board350–800gsm reinforced bottom card depending load requirement
Load capacity2–8 kg practical carrying load based on size and paper GSM
Surface finishMatte lamination, gloss lamination, hot foil, embossing, spot UV
PrintingOffset 1–6 colors; PMS spot color matching ΔE ≤ 3.0
Size tolerance±2 mm width/height/gusset after folding
Glue seamHot-melt or water-based glue; seam width 8–12 mm
RFQ dataBag W×H×G, handle type, paper GSM, load target, logo artwork
MOQ500 PCS per custom size / artwork
Artwork fileAI / PDF / PSD accepted; vector logo required; 3 mm bleed
Color toleranceΔE ≤ 3.0 against approved digital proof
Dimension tolerance±2 mm for flexible packaging; ±1.5 mm for paper boxes unless stated
Quality inspectionAQL 2.5 for major defects; random inspection before shipment
RFQ data requiredSize, product weight, filling condition, artwork, quantity, destination port/country

RFQ Checklist for Factory Quotation

  1. Confirm exact size in mm, product filling weight and target shelf life.
  2. Send AI/PDF artwork with 3 mm bleed and barcode/QR code position.
  3. Choose material structure, surface finish, closure and export carton requirement.
  4. Tell us destination country, quantity and delivery method for freight calculation.
